chunks.text: Canal Cockburn is a hydrographic feature of southern Magallanes. SBAP/SIMBIO recognizes it as a geoform of the marine ecosystem Cockburn Magdalena - Magallanes (ECOMAR-056).

Canal Cockburn is also named in an official subbasin of the basin Islas al Sur Estrecho de Magallanes, linking it spatially with Isla Santa Ines and Canal Barbara. These biodiversity-system records are suitable for general geographic context, not navigation guidance.
